argument:
Visa combines growing comparable revenue and profit, strong positive FCF and debt below its year-ago observation. Price remains above SMA50 and SMA200, with a positive longer-period return, so the fundamental buy has independent trend support.

Inference: a measured entry can participate in a cash-generating business with resilient momentum while avoiding the weakest AI-related tapes. The merchant settlement still needs approval and the provider P/E is unreconciled, so neither litigation resolution nor cheapness is assumed. Cooling MACD argues for deliberate execution, not dismissal of the broader positive evidence.
key_points: Consistent comparable growth and strong FCF
